title: polypodium angustifolium var. lucidum
intro: Polypodium angustifolium var. lucidum, commonly known as the Shining Oak Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include being a natural anti-inflammatory agent, aiding in wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and exhibit analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Polypodium angustifolium var. lucidum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
